description.value: Queens Cross is a neighborhood pub on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, serving a full kitchen menu alongside a cold beer and wine store. The pub broadcasts live sports across 14+ screens and a projector, covering NFL, CFL, NHL, and golf. Families with minors are welcome until 8:30 PM, making it a practical stop for cycling groups of mixed ages.

address.value: 2989 Lonsdale Ave, North Vancouver, BC V7N 3J3
